purpose: prevent an arbitrary ordering of scientifically unordered information blocks from determining the claimed held-out transfer ceiling

input_requirements.information_blocks: non-empty, named, mutually variable-disjoint and disjoint from the fixed base
input_requirements.subset_score_table: one held-out score vector for every one of the 2^m subsets of m declared information blocks

edge_estimand: held-out score gain for S -> S union {z} within each independent group
point_edge_success_rule: an edge is generalizing only when its gain is positive in every independent group
path_rule: a full path succeeds only when every consecutive edge in that information-block ordering is all-group successful; total full-vs-base gain cannot skip a failed edge
block_order_robust_rule: one information block is order-robust generalizing only when every lattice edge adding that block is all-group positive

shapley_role.purpose: descriptive order-average of held-out marginal score contribution

familywise_certification.family: all estimable independent-group by lattice-edge cells

complexity.intended_use: a modest number of scientifically meaningful information blocks rather than raw high-dimensional feature attribution
